summary: Registered 2026-10-22 and starting its FIRST run; no trial has run yet, so there is no ledger. 'awaiting_rerun' is the closest the vocabulary offers (awaiting_rerun | abandoned | complete) -- there is no 'registered, never run' state, and inventing one would fail the check that makes an unexplained empty registration impossible.
why: This is NOT Task 37. Task 37's claim is that only the DATA changes against Task 36, so it must use Task 36's proposer (claude-haiku-4-5). This uses deepseek-v4-pro and is therefore a different experiment that happens to share the apparatus, written to its own directory with its own campaign ids.

What it can be compared to: Task 37's arms at the same planted strength, and its own other arm. What it CANNOT be compared to: Task 36's no-signal arms, because those ran on a different proposer -- so this run on its own cannot separate search from the self-flattery Task 36 measured.

max_tokens is 100,000, not Task 37's 16,384. deepseek-v4-pro was measured emitting 88,799 completion tokens on a single call, 76,337 of them reasoning; 16,384 would truncate every trial. The parameter was sized from that measurement and frozen at registration.
why_run_it: The committee vetoed nq-orderflow-absorption-02 because the winning strategy never built a volume profile. A rehearsal showed deepseek-v4-pro does build one, and passes the Amendment 11 refinement haiku failed 5 of 5 times. This asks the harder question the rehearsal cannot: with a known edge planted in the data, does this proposer find it and does the gate accept?
